title: Has anyone else noticed a recent uptick in anomalous events? (Syncronicities, vivid dreams, etc…)
content: I’m curious if anyone else has had particularly strong or numerous synchronicities or mallworld dreams in the last month or so. In the last few weeks I’ve had a few things happen that are so spectacularly unlikely and/or unusual that at this point I’m almost completely convinced there is some sort of “astral plane” or universal consciousness or something linking together separate people and separate times. I like Paul Stamets idea of a universal mycelial network that connects all space and time in some higher dimension that we can tap into occasionally under the right circumstances. I won’t give specifics at the moment so I’m not influencing what people describe.
